headline.zh-CN: 完善副主催协作权限边界

summary.zh-CN: 副主催的问题处理、外部曲师代传、社团成员退出和专辑导出现在会遵循更完整的身份与资源范围校验。
summary.en: Issue handling, external-composer proxy submissions, circle departures, and album exports now follow more complete identity and resource-scope checks for co-producers.

title.zh-CN: 问题处理入口匹配实际指派

description.zh-CN: 副主催可处理没有指定评审人的主催阶段问题；自定义评审阶段已有明确指派时，页面会遵循该指派显示操作入口。
description.en: Co-producers can handle producer-stage issues without an assigned reviewer, while custom review stages with explicit assignments now show controls according to those assignments.

title.zh-CN: 外部曲师代传身份保持一致

description.zh-CN: 仅包含外部曲师的曲目会由实际代传者继续执行曲师侧操作，不会错误转交给专辑主催。
description.en: For tracks containing only external composers, composer-side actions remain with the actual proxy uploader instead of being assigned to the album producer.

title.zh-CN: 成员退出后同步撤销关联权限

description.zh-CN: 成员离开社团或被移除后，关联专辑成员身份、评审指派和待处理邀请会同步更新，避免继续保留社团来源的访问权限。
description.en: When a member leaves or is removed from a circle, related album membership, review assignments, and pending invitations are updated so circle-derived access does not remain.

title.zh-CN: 专辑导出链接绑定对应专辑
title.en: Album export links stay bound to their album

description.zh-CN: 导出下载标识只对创建该导出的专辑有效，并在下载完成或过期后清理临时文件。
description.en: Export download identifiers are valid only for the album that created them, with temporary files cleaned up after download or expiration.
